_comment: The three training upgrade units. 'min' is the starting value, 'max' the highest value an upgrade unit can train. Descriptions are the game's own help text (STATHELP.STR / SKILHELP.STR).

entries.label: Strength
entries.name: Strength (STR)
entries.desc: Strength determines your inventory capacity, and the amount of damage you inflict in hand-to-hand combat. All armor and some weapons have a minimum STR requirement.

entries.label: Endurance
entries.name: Endurance (END)
entries.desc: Endurance determines your maximum hit points, and your resistance to radiation and toxins.

entries.label: Psionics
entries.name: Psionic Ability (PSI)
entries.desc: Psionic Ability determines your skill in using psionic disciplines. The duration, range, and damage inflicted by psionic disciplines can depend on PSI.

entries.label: Agility
entries.name: Agility (AGI)
entries.desc: Agility determines your movement speed, and reduces falling damage and weapon kickback.

entries.label: Cyber
entries.name: Cybernetic Affinity (CYB)
entries.desc: Cybernetic Affinity improves your chances of successfully using the Hack, Repair, and Modify skills, and also lessens the number of dangerous nodes.

entries.label: Standard
entries.name: Standard Weapons
entries.desc: This skill increases the amount of damage you inflict with standard weapons. Some standard weapons have a minimum skill requirement.

entries.label: Energy
entries.name: Energy Weapons
entries.desc: This skill increases the amount of damage you inflict with energy weapons. Some energy weapons have a minimum skill requirement.

entries.label: Heavy
entries.name: Heavy Weapons
entries.desc: This skill increases the amount of damage you inflict with heavy weapons. Some heavy weapons have a minimum skill requirement.

entries.label: Exotic
entries.name: Exotic Weapons
entries.desc: This skill increases the amount of damage you inflict with exotic weapons. Some exotic weapons have a minimum skill requirement.

entries.label: Hack
entries.name: Hacking
entries.desc: The Hacking skill determines your chances of hacking various computer systems.

entries.label: Repair
entries.name: Repair
entries.desc: The Repair skill determines your chances of repairing broken weapons or computer systems.

entries.label: Modify
entries.name: Modify
entries.desc: The Modify skill determines your chances of modifying a weapon to an improved state.

entries.label: Maintain
entries.name: Maintenance
entries.desc: The Maintenance skill determines the amount of improvement you can make to the condition of a weapon. You must have a Maintenance Tool to use this skill.

entries.label: Research
entries.name: Research
entries.desc: The Research skill determines the efficiency of your research. Researching alien organs can yield useful information, and some items cannot be used without first being researched.
